description: This Python module provides functions to generate Bokeh visualization components for various monitoring pages (bad pixel, bias, dark, readnoise) in the jwql web application. It imports Bokeh components and references external modules for monitor page templates and constants, and defines functions that create tabbed layouts with plots and images for different instruments and parameters.

methods.name: bad_pixel_monitor_tabs
methods.description: Creates tabbed layout with plots/images for bad pixel monitoring for a specified instrument.

methods.name: bias_monitor_tabs
methods.description: Creates tabbed layout with bias monitoring plots/images for a specified instrument.

methods.name: dark_monitor_tabs
methods.description: Creates tabbed layout with dark current monitoring plots/images for a specified instrument.

methods.name: readnoise_monitor_tabs
methods.description: Creates tabbed layout with readnoise monitoring plots/images for a specified instrument.
